protocol.purpose: Saved-v18 experiment separating menu-selection readiness from message readiness; no production changes
protocol.messageGate: A filled menu cursor never by itself confirms a new message. Existing genuine message-complete/fading state, a down arrow in the main message box, or 100ms of unchanged message fields confirms it; keep the confirmation only while the current message signature is unchanged.
protocol.menuGate: Menu-only pages retain v18 rules. Mixed pages expose menuReady and messageReady separately. Existing redraw/scroll/clear states remain ineligible.
protocol.pcSuspensionGate: On a currently identified pc_prompt, a hollow parent selection in renderer column1 with no active child selection to its right blocks message publication until a main-message arrow, active child or changed context is observed. Source-backed PC item-operation semantics, not clip identity or wording.
protocol.negativeControl: Blanket suppression of all hollow-only menus is deliberately compared to expose loss of legitimate merchant messages; it is not the selected rule.
protocol.signature: Message clock uses only currently observed message regions, marks and positions. Whole-candidate dedup keeps the previous experiment's full raw signature; no count reduction by ignoring selection changes.
protocol.observationClock: Original integer PTS; no future or between-frame timer events; reset at existing clip boundary with real warmup
protocol.residualFalseTrigger: Same frozen loading/message_loading definition as previous comparison
protocol.pageDetection: Same116 frozen page opportunities and strict-key raw/final text scores as previous comparison; all duplicate observations must be ready
protocol.shortPage: Same complete-frame duration strictly below200ms; do not discard or extend short pages
protocol.delay: Source-PTS readiness lower bound only, not actual UI latency; misses excluded from quantiles and reported separately
successCriteria: Retain each of the previously rescued20 pages with final-correct text within200ms
No new missed page or short-page miss
List every remaining or newly introduced transition failure
protocol.boundaries: Never read GT, clip/frame IDs, fixed messages or future observations in a policy. No GT/scorer/OCR changes; all previous production repair limits remain. This is development evidence, not independent acceptance.

existingAggregateUnchanged.overlapRule: One original frame counted once. Max edit errors and conjunction of exact geometry/state/symbol correctness across every replay of overlapping ranges; never select a successful replay to hide a failure.

coverageAndGaps.outputIndependence: Corrections read from original images in two passes without tested outputs. Existing OCR and prior diagnostic awareness disclosed; no claim of a fresh independent acceptance session.
coverageAndGaps.sessionPartition: development only; independence unverified; acceptance empty

withdrawnPage.reason: Only frame of historical opportunity is partially erased old message after menu disappearance. Original102-frame double read establishes continuing erase through1922; not a new complete page. Keep every frame scored and retain old opportunity record here; do not count as a passed page.

limitations: All four videos remain the only media; only selected frozen clips are covered. Unselected time and missing dimensions remain unverified.
Uses saved raw v18 text and existing status hints, not pixel replay, new OCR, translation, wall-clock scheduling or actual UI rendering.
Arrow and original100ms baselines exactly reproduce the previous experiment. New gates independently confirm message fields; menu cursors alone cannot certify a new message.

The PC suspension gate uses current pc_prompt classification and current parent/child cursors. Merchant hollow-only messages are a counterexample to a blanket rule. Unknown/uncovered PC operations remain unverified.
Excluding sourceRect drift and arrow blinking from a temporal signature is diagnostic design, not normalization of existing strict scores.
Correct-text page counts keep existing strict role/grid-start/order matching, but do not certify source rectangles, all frames, symbols or completion state.
A page can be detected correctly and still have had earlier residual false triggers; both metrics must be considered together.
Delay is a source-time lower bound from frame observations; processing, capture delivery, queue, translation and UI costs are excluded. Misses are not assigned zero delay.
No timer event is invented between frames or at clip end, and policies reset at each existing replay boundary with its real warmup.
GT semantic qualification and independent acceptance remain unverified. This parameter sweep uses development data and is not independent validation.
